ops.fn: () => { const es=[...document.querySelectorAll('.battle-enemy')]; es.forEach((e,i)=>{ if(e.querySelector(':scope > .battle-status-icons')) return; const c=document.createElement('span'); c.className='battle-status-icons'; const kinds=[['paralysis','마비'],['burn','화상'],['def-down',null]]; const k=kinds[i%3]; const s=document.createElement('span'); s.className='battle-status-icon battle-status-icon-'+k[0]; s.dataset.statusIcon=k[0]; if(k[1]) s.dataset.statusLabel=k[1]; c.append(s); e.append(c); }); return es.length; }

() => { const out={tag:'crows'}; const q=(s)=>[...document.querySelectorAll(s)]; const R=(n)=>{const r=n.getBoundingClientRect(); return {x:Math.round(r.left),y:Math.round(r.top),w:Math.round(r.width),h:Math.round(r.height)}}; out.enemies=q('.battle-enemy').map(n=>({id:n.dataset.testid||n.className.slice(0,40),node:R(n),img:n.querySelector('img,canvas,.battle-enemy-image')?R(n.querySelector('img,canvas,.battle-enemy-image')):null,chrome:n.querySelector('.battle-enemy-chrome')?R(n.querySelector('.battle-enemy-chrome')):null, z:getComputedStyle(n).zIndex, pos:getComputedStyle(n).position, filter:getComputedStyle(n).filter, ctx:getComputedStyle(n).isolation})); out.reasons=q('.battle-command-reason').map(n=>({t:n.textContent,box:R(n),sh:n.scrollHeight,ch:n.clientHeight,sw:n.scrollWidth,cw:n.clientWidth})); out.menu=q('.battle-command-menu').map(R); out.stage=document.querySelector('.battle-scene')?R(document.querySelector('.battle-scene')):null; out.cmdparty=q('[data-testid=battle-party-panel],.battle-party').map(R); out.topwin=q('[data-testid=battle-message],.battle-message-window,.battle-help-window').map(R); return out; }
